Hi Olivia \u0014 thanks for the heads up and sorry for the confusion.

Short answer: our Calendly booking page should respect the browser/timezone of the person booking, but we've seen a few cases where Calendly caches a previous timezone preference (especially across DST boundary shifts).

Workarounds we can do right away:
- I can manually create the Google Calendar invite for 11:00 BST (10:00 UTC) on Thu 18 Jun and send it over \u0014 that avoids Calendly entirely.
- Alternatively, try the Chili Piper redirect link (below) which a few EU customers have found less prone to DST-cache issues.
- If you prefer Calendly, try clearing cookies for calendly.com or open the link in an incognito window and re-select Europe/London from the timezone dropdown before confirming.

I'll go ahead and create a manual invite now for 11:00 BST and loop Marissa (who handles calendar ops) to confirm it shows correctly in our organizer before we send.

Links:
Calendly (what you used): https://calendly.com/redwood/camila-demo
Chili Piper quick-book: https://app.chilipiper.com/redirect/demo/camila

Thanks \u0014 talk soon.

\u0014 Camila Reyes
